fea.note: HUBB_Ah on the final rev E1 shape, global element 6.0 with the fine zones, Intel direct sparse; 1 mm ball 4.20 / 3.54 / 2.68. Not converged by the rule: a finer global mesh passes the 14 GB limit of the direct solver, and on rev D3c7 the same step (4.5 against 2.6) moved the layer figure from 0.91 to 0.65

HUBL_G90YAWP_MAX, 1.19 M nodes; 1.56 is the governing figure (shear across the layers at the lug), entered as bulk. Run on the first rev E1 shape; the later edits (hole edges, step fillet, head seats) do not touch the lugs, but the run has not been repeated on this export
HUBL_STOP6_ZB; 3.10 is the governing figure of the read-out, entered for both marks. Run on the first rev E1 shape, not repeated on this export

access.method: by geometry, not a ray check: the six M4 heads sit on the tube ends in the open centre bore and take a straight driver from the arm side before the arm goes on; the arm thread compared this export with the released hub below Y 302 (identical) and checked its cable route (3.64 mm smallest clearance)
access.notes: the RS02 output thread depth (7 mm on the drawing) is not measured on a real motor
